reference.description: User-selected six-icon pixel cursor sheet with black outlines, ivory fills, localized pale-yellow shading, a red prohibited state, and a gold hourglass.

processing: Mechanical six-cell crop from the selected reference, exterior-canvas removal, nearest-neighbor point sampling, and placement on a 32x32 transparent canvas. Source RGB samples are retained without recoloring, palette replacement, smoothing, or shape redesign. pressed.png is pointer.png shifted one pixel down and right.
constraints: Preserve the reference's localized pale-yellow and gold pixels
Transparent RGBA PNG with binary 0/255 alpha
Visible artwork is 26 to 28 pixels tall rather than browser-scaled
Touch, canvas, iframe, and forced-colors surfaces keep native or application-owned cursor behavior
